title: Testimonials
description: Quote/name/role rotator backend. Public `listAll` + `get` queries (no auth — testimonials are public), admin `create` / `update` / `remove`, internal `seed` for one-shot bootstrap. Indexed by `order` so the carousel/grid keeps stable rotation. Lifted 2026-05-16 from rahmanef.com; sanitized: token-based admin gate swapped for `requireAdmin(ctx)` from `_shared/auth`.
